strengths: Implemented robust YAML parsing and T25 strict loader to enforce schema and reject duplicate keys/IDs across golden test cases.
Normalized Google model IDs by removing the 'models/' prefix to resolve id_absent probe mismatches.
Enforced explicit max_tokens parameter across all LLM client calls to prevent 402 context window rejection errors on OpenRouter.
Verified offline test suite (25/25 tests passing) prior to remote operations.
weaknesses: Remote CI execution and post-push raw HTTP payload hash validation remain pending until the next workflow run.

decisions.open_point: Handling OpenRouter 402 errors and variable free model aliases
decisions.decision: Set explicit max_tokens per request type, flag dynamic free models with low_confidence, and convert 402 responses to terminal needs_credit state.
decisions.rationale: Prevents context overflow rejections, avoids consuming rate limits on retry loops, and isolates variable model metrics from benchmark baselines.

risks: OpenRouter free models dynamically alias to different backend architectures between runs, introducing variability in response metadata.
Quota consumption on shared daily buckets resets at 00:00 UTC, constraining immediate live CI re-evaluations.
